headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth in Q2 FY27, with AI‑driven firms outpacing slower‑guidance peers.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, led by high‑growth players like Coforge and HCLTech. Profitability was mixed; Infosys trimmed guidance while Wipro saw profit dip. AI revenue contributions were highlighted by several firms, indicating a shift toward higher‑margin services. Guidance ranges from modest (1‑2%) to raised outlooks for a few companies.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies such as HCLTech, Mphasis and Infosys reported strong AI revenue growth, boosting margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY growth, while traditional giants like Infosys and Wipro delivered single‑digit increases.

themes.title: Margin pressure on legacy players
themes.detail: Despite revenue gains, firms like Infosys and Wipro face tighter operating margins and lower profit growth.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
AI revenue rose to $219 m, driving a 21% profit jump and solid operating margin.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to ~1% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and guidance is flat.
